args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary for June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera or smartphone with waterproof case
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Evening attire (for the luau on June 16)
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented at Hanauma Bay)
- Small backpack for day trips
- Medications and first aid supplies
- Insect repellent
- Power bank for electronics
- Travel adapter if needed
